overview_description.description:
Kustomer is the omnichannel SaaS CRM platform reimagining enterprise customer service to deliver standout experiences. It scales to meet the needs of any contact center and business by unifying data from multiple sources, enabling companies to deliver service and support through a single timeline view. Kustomer is the core platform of some of the leading customer service brands like Ring, Glovo, Glossier, Sweetgreen, Away, Rent the Runway, and UNTUCKit.

The company was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in New York.

about_short_description.short_description: Kustomer is an omnichannel Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) CRM platform specializing in customer service.

product.name: Kustomer Customer Service CRM Platform
product.description: A cloud-based customer service CRM that unifies customer data, conversation history, and support interactions across channels in a single workspace.

product.name: Kustomer Concierge
product.description: An AI customer service agent that uses customer context to resolve routine and complex requests across chat, email, SMS, WhatsApp, and voice, with configurable human escalation.

product.name: Kustomer Envoy
product.description: An AI assistance layer for customer service representatives that provides customer context, real-time guidance, and interaction insights within support workflows.

product.name: Kustomer Architect
product.description: A visual tool for designing, deploying, testing, and improving AI-powered customer service workflows and experiences without requiring extensive engineering work.

product.name: Kustomer Data Explorer
product.description: An AI-powered CX analytics tool that answers operational questions in natural language and provides metrics, visualizations, explanations, and recommendations.

product.name: Kustomer Agent Service
product.description: A customer service solution that gives representatives unified customer timelines, automated workflows, skill-based routing, and performance reporting for support operations.
